messages:
Marta L: quick heads-up — nightly perf job flagged a throughput regression when we switch kernel paths around seqlen 384..512 on A100s. looks like some requests are being routed to the decode-optimized kernels too early and thrashing KV cache.
Rahul P: can you paste the perf counters / sample logs? is this only on a specific model/quant profile?
Marta L: model: redwood-7b-quant4; hw: a100-80gb; quant: q4f32; observed ~14% drop in tok/s for mixed prefill+decode flows. attaching snippet: 
```
2024-03-02T03:14:21Z INFO run=nightly profile=seq-sweep seqlen=400 path=selected=decode_kernel_v2 latency_ms=1.12 kv_hit=0.03 batch=8
2024-03-02T03:14:21Z INFO run=nightly profile=seq-sweep seqlen=400 path=fallback=prefill_kernel_v1 latency_ms=0.95 kv_hit=0.58 batch=8
2024-03-02T03:14:22Z WARN run=nightly decision_confidence=0.18 recent_var=0.22
```
Marta L: tl;dr: lower kv_hit after switching path, higher latency variance, autotuner picks decode path based on micro-batch util heuristics but misses cache-warmth signal.
Kevin S: interesting — autotuner currently uses mean latency + batch_util for path picks. we never encoded a kv-warmth or cache-hit signal.
Olivia C: can we add a short-term "path_confidence" metric that combines kv_hit_rate, recent latency variance, and steady-state throughput? simple exponential moving avg, maybe 1s window.
Rahul P: +1. also would help if the decision logic had a hysteresis: require confidence > threshold for N consecutive windows before flip. avoids flip-flop around the 384 boundary.
CI Bot: nightly/regression — job=seq-sweep-1709500000 status=regression detected=throughput_drop pct=14 model=redwood-7b-quant4 infra=a100-80gb
Dave R: i sketched a tiny config to try:
```yaml
autotune:
  path_confidence_window_s: 1.0
  path_confidence_threshold: 0.6
  min_warmup_samples: 20
  kv_weight: 0.5
  var_penalty: 0.3
  hysteresis_windows: 3
```
Dave R: idea: compute confidence = sigmoid(kv_weight*kv_hit + (1-kv_weight)*(1-var)) then require > threshold for hysteresis_windows to accept switch.
Marta L: that looks good. want to run A/B where group A uses current logic, group B uses confidence+hysteresis + prefer prefills when kv_hit < 0.4.
Kevin S: we should also record a "misroute" counter whenever path switch occurs mid-request group and kv_hit drops > 0.25 within next 2s. useful for regression alerts.
Olivia C: can we add a lightweight in-runtime profiler tag to surface the KV cache state per request? e.g., kv_state=warm|cold|ambiguous. low overhead boolean based on cache-lookup hit-rate.
Rahul P: +1. if we can push that into the metrics pipeline we can retro-fit analysis on old traces too.
Marta L: action items: (1) Dave implement config & simple confidence calc in autotuner branch (2) Kevin add misroute counter and meter kv_state (3) run A/B on a100 pool for 24h, compare tok/s and kv_hit delta.
Kevin S: happy to take (2). will also add a small dashboard tile: path_switches, misroutes, avg_kv_hit by seqlen bucket.
Marta L: thanks — i'll open an experiment PR and tag folks. goal: eliminate the 10-15% regression and reduce flip-flops around 384..512.
Olivia C: FYI we saw a similar pattern on ampere-gen2 last year but it was smaller; might be amplified by quantization kernel differences here.
Rahul P: if this lands, recommend a canary that forces new logic only for redwood-7b-quant4 first. slow rollout.
Marta L: agreed. i'll post the PR link and the test matrix in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
